quest.title: Cooking, a Pleasant Memory
quest.description: According to Arachatora, his brother Arasaka is doing "cooking training" near Gandharva Ville. Look for a pillar of smoke near Gandharva Ville!
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x20000, Recipe: Selva Salad x1

dialogues.text: You consume the dew and grow up quickly...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hello! You're Ara... Ara... What was it again?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's smart!
Grow, grow, turn into a delicious dish...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: He doesn't seem to notice us...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Arasaka! Are you Arasaka?

talks.objective: Approach the Aranara by the Zaytun Peaches

dialogues.text: Eek! Nara... So tall, so scary...
Please, I beg you... Don't pluck them...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, we won't do it.
Great. Hehe... I grew these Zaytun Peaches little by little, ever since they were seeds...
Wait, no! Bad Nara! How could you do that to someone else's Zaytun Peaches?
Wh—Why does Nara have such a terrible habit...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We didn't do anything and haven't picked them!
It's already scary when you guys didn't do anything. If you had really done something, it would scare me to death!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey!

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: No, no, Arasaka... Think about it. You've worked so hard on these Zaytun Peaches for your cooking training... You cannot back out here. You are not scared...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, you're Arasaka.

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: Oh! H—How do you know my name... Where you Nara all come from... T—To know my name at first sight...

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: Problems are caused by a loose tongue. It's over! My name will be used in terrible curses... Please, please, spare me...

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: Other than giving you the Zaytun Peaches, I will do anything...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Easy now. We're actually here because of Arapacati's request.

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: Ara—Arapacati? Ah, my dear "younger sister," sunlight in the dense forest...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You bring Arasaka up to speed on the events so far...

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: Ugh... How come Festival Utsava is already approaching... Oh, are you two the Nara who have come to participate in this Festival Utsava?

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: Sorry for calling you bad Nara. You must be good Nara because only good Nara can enter Vanarana and participate in Festival Utsava.

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: Festival Utsava is coming. If I give up my cooking training and return to Vanarana now... No... But I can't skip Festival Utsava either...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why are you getting more nervous instead? Don't you still have the Zaytun Peaches you planted?

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: Th—That's not enough!

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: There has to be the "taste of happiness." Without it, Zaytun Peaches will just be Zaytun Peaches...

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: Arachatora, Arapas, and Araphala all don't believe that the "taste of happiness" exists. I will make it and show them. And I want Nara to try it too.

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: Hehe, "taste of happiness"... I tried it once.

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: "Taste of happiness." It's white, crumbles when you rub it... Turns into white Valuka, but is not hard and painful like Valuka. Stored in a hard bubble.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: White Valuka refers to white sand, right? Uh, but what's a hard bubble...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon can't figure it out. Where can we find that "taste of happiness"?

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: Wh—Why are you asking me? Do you want to take the "taste of happiness" before I do? How scary...

choices.text: We only want to help you...

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: Help me? With what? I—I can get it myself...

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: It's just that there are a lot of Nara walking about, and one that smells like Nara Valuka. Ugh... Too many Nara! I'm scared... If there were fewer Nara, I could do it then...

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: ...Okay, true, I can't get it. I... don't dare to enter Gandharva Ville. There are too many Nara there, and all the dead trees. I'm scared.

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: I have a Nara friend living inside. But a long, long time has passed. He's changed now and can't hear my voice.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So the "taste of happiness" you're talking about can actually be found in Gandharva Ville.

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: The "taste of happiness" is not grown from the ground but made by Nara.

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: I really want to taste it again. I still remember the first time I tasted it and how happy I was. It was an amazing, amazing taste.

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: We were in the forest together with the Nara friend, counting the number of patches of sunlight that fell between the leaves.

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: We sang together and tried the "taste of happiness" together. Every time I see the sunlight on branches, I will think of him. Every time I think of him, I remember the "taste of happiness."

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: So, I want to let Arapacati taste it. And when Festival Utsava starts, I want Nara to taste it too.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Paimon sees. Then leave it to {NICKNAME} and Paimon! Right, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: I want to have happiness too.

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: Really? You are not lying to me?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Nope!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But there are so many people in Gandharva Ville! Who should we ask for clues?

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: I know. Not long ago, I saw a Nara passing by here, <color=#00E1FFFF>going to Gandharva Ville</color>. And he had it with him.

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: He had a bulging thing on his back. It's what Nara use to carry things.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A bulge on the back... Hm. <color=#00E1FFFF>It is probably a bag or a back basket</color>.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Got it! We'll help you find the "taste of happiness" now!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Paimon just wants to help Arasaka!

choices.text: The "taste of happiness" you're talking about is...
We knew a long time ago.

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: What!? A long time ago!? So you had your eyes on me long ago... Wh—What do you want from me...

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: Could it be the Zaytun Peaches? No! You can have anything else! But not my peaches!

talks.objective: Head to Gandharva Ville and look for someone "with a bulge on their back"

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: H—How was it? Did you find the "taste of happiness"? It's in Gandharva Ville...

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: There's a Nara with a bulging thing on his back. The "taste of happiness" must be inside...

talks.objective: Talk to the person "with a bulge on their back"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hello!

dialogues.speaker: Iaanesh
dialogues.text: Oh, hello... How can I help you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Right, we actually want a certain thing...

dialogues.speaker: Iaanesh
dialogues.text: Heh. Of course, everyone comes here to get "a certain thing." But just saying "a certain thing" doesn't mean I know what this "certain thing" is.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh... Paimon gets it. Let Paimon put it this way: We want...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Something white and cubic...

dialogues.speaker: Iaanesh
dialogues.text: White and cubic?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Right, and it crumbles like sand when crushed, and it has to be packed in a hard bubble!

dialogues.speaker: Iaanesh
dialogues.text: What a peculiar description...

dialogues.speaker: Iaanesh
dialogues.text: It's not clear what it is from what you said, but what does this white and cubic thing you've described do?

dialogues.speaker: Iaanesh
dialogues.text: The use of the thing. You know what it's used for, right?

response.speaker: Iaanesh
response.text: An edible, white, and cubic thing...?

response.speaker: Iaanesh
response.text: Oh! I know! I know what you want... Hahaha...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What's so funny!?

response.speaker: Iaanesh
response.text: Aha, hahaha! White, cubic, crumbles when crushed, becomes sand... and can be eaten...

response.speaker: Iaanesh
response.text: Isn't it just "sugar"!?

response.speaker: Iaanesh
response.text: The hard bubble... Are you talking about the glass bottle that sugar is stored in? My goodness! Hard bubble! Hahahahaha...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What? So it's sugar...

response.speaker: Iaanesh
response.text: Ooh, I laughed so much I cried. I've focused on my business the past few years, and I don't even remember when was the last time I laughed like this...

response.speaker: Iaanesh
response.text: Speaking of which, it's really nostalgic. I remember a long time ago, when I was still a child, I once had a friend who ate sugar for the first time, and the friend said similar things.

response.speaker: Iaanesh
response.text: "This white cubic thing is delicious! So awesome! The taste of happiness!" He was really amazed then.

response.speaker: Iaanesh
response.text: Haha... It was so long ago, and now that I think about it, I don't even remember what he looked like.

response.speaker: Iaanesh
response.text: Oh! I'll give you this bottle of sugar as a gift in return for the laughter.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Thanks.

response.speaker: Iaanesh
response.text: Hold it carefully. The hard bubble might be hard, but it can still break if dropped. "Hard bubble"! Hahahahaha!

response.speaker: Iaanesh
response.text: Cooking, white, cubic... Is it a seasoning?

dialogues.speaker: Iaanesh
dialogues.text: My family has always been a merchant group on the move, from The Chasm to Sumeru. We import rare gemstones from Liyue, then send spices over.

dialogues.speaker: Iaanesh
dialogues.text: Once, because something came up... I can't remember. Anyway, my father left me in Gandharva Ville for a very long time.

dialogues.speaker: Iaanesh
dialogues.text: I remember I was in the forest, and I made a friend. We ran around together, then...

dialogues.speaker: Iaanesh
dialogues.text: I don't remember what happened later. I can't remember his name, or what he looked like...

dialogues.speaker: Iaanesh
dialogues.text: I only remember it being a really happy time. Then my father finally came back, and picked me up. I'd also thought to go back and look for him but I never had the opportunity, and I eventually forgot about this experience.

dialogues.speaker: Iaanesh
dialogues.text: If it wasn't for you asking me for sugar, I would have forgotten about all these things. Why would it be like this...

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: That's the one! I didn't think you would get it so quickly... Is it real?

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: You didn't just make something up to trick me, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It would be a miracle if we were able to make anything that made sense up from your description!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If you're worried, just try it yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: ...You didn't put anything strange in it, did you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Of course not! Hmph! If you're not trying it, we're gonna take it away.

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: N—No, wait! Don't take it away. Let me... Let me try...

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: Don't take it away, alright? I'll try it now, right now... Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: Ah, it's real... This is the "taste of happiness"! Hehe... This isn't the first time I tasted it, and yet I still feel happy.

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: I didn't expect to ever taste this again... Ah, but...

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: Well... How should I put this? The "taste of happiness" is the same as before. But for some reason, I don't feel as happy as the first time I tasted it...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Could it be that the sugar he gave us was not sweet enough?

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: No, it's not a difference in the taste. But when I ate it with my friend in the past... That was the first time I tasted the "taste of happiness"...

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: Somehow I feel that I was much happier back then. Why is that?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #That's normal. Even if it's the same dish, the taste is different every time {NICKNAME} makes it...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's mood is different every time Paimon eats it too.

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: No, it can't be... There must be a way for me to be as happy as then...

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: I know! I had it with my friend at the time. So the "taste of happiness" has to be shared with friends for it to be delicious, right?

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: That must be it. You are good Nara, and you found the "taste of happiness." You, are my friends. I'm going to make it for you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, we're friends!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Arasaka starts cooking right away and adds peaches and sugar into the pot...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Arasaka then hands the finished product to you and Paimon.\nAs expected, it doesn't have much flavor other than the overwhelming "sweetness."\nMaybe this is just the "taste of happiness"...

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: Ah, what a happy flavor. It's exquisite.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yes, this dish is quite...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Quite "happy."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon thinks it's much too sweet too...

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: R—Really? Oh, I guess I must've put too much in one go, then.

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: But... Hehe. It's true that the "taste of happiness" is happier when shared with friends.

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: It is different from the happiness I felt the first time I had it, but eating it with you guys... I feel a different kind of happiness.

choices.text: Well, as long as you're happy.

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: I had doubts about you guys in the beginning, but you didn't hold any grudge... and you helped me find the "taste of happiness"...

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: I was able to complete my Supreme Delicacy with your help and complete my cooking training...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's nothing, really...

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: No, how is it nothing? You've helped me so much...

response.speaker: Arasaka
response.text: That's right, I know! I'll teach you how to make this dish so you can share the "taste of happiness" with your friends.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Hmm... If we modify the formula and add a little something extra, it should make a good snack...)

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: I—I now just have to let them taste this Supreme Delicacy and they will understand what the "taste of happiness" is.

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: Arapacati will surely like it...

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: No, bad Nara! You're... You're not allowed to pick my peaches!

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: I said don't pick them! They're for the "taste of happiness"!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Arasaka, this is the "taste of happiness" you wanted, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We brought it back from Gandharva Ville.
